changes.title: Keep Runic Slash enchantment power for the actual attack
changes.text: Weapon reach previews now calculate enchantment power without consuming Runic Slash or other one-use buffs. The attack still consumes effects normally. Projecting reach is finite within the playable floor, with +6 Runic Slash giving eight tiles without other modifiers; ninth tile is rejected. Normal attack reach and all other combat mechanics remain unchanged.

changes.title: Show source-based Arcana effects and uncorrupted reach
changes.text: Replaced the unreadable range arrow with ASCII wording and added separate Arcana-only melee/missile Projecting radius, Runic Slash power and total live reach. All 48 shipped enchantments, glyphs and curses now have individual named explanations, plus source-calculated strength values where deterministic. Hidden identities and unknown upgrade values remain private.

changes.title: Regress Runic range, real Arcana ring buffs and all effect text
changes.text: Source-level regression checks include actual Projecting canReach boundaries, normal versus +6 Runic Slash, one-use buff retention, ring Arcana levels zero, two and eight, finite floor overflow protection, effect-specific descriptions, numeric outputs and clean English localization. Full 2046-method/397-suite core run passed; earlier fixture compilation failure and exact corrections remain documented. Native/physical acceptance is separate.

changes.text: This intentionally requested private build uses the immediately previous compiled developer TEST305, preserving every verified historical record and separately producing developer and player APKs.
